system.description: Once per encounter, you can spend a Force Point as a Standard Action to call upon the vengeful spirits of the ancient Sith. Doing so grants you 3 Followers with the Vengeful Spirit Template. These Followers appear in any unoccupied square adjacent to you, and last until the end of the encounter (at which point they vanish).

prerequisite.text: Dark Side Adept talent, and Dark Side Master talent

nodes.text: Dark Side Adept talent, and Dark Side Master talent
